## 3. The input budget

Every node of the map that is presently an input of main's spine, grouped by the choice it names. The same choice
stands under several names across the record. The kinds follow the record's own grades where it has them; the
builder checks them against GENESIS's grades and the scoreboard's types. Their independence is the record's listing.

**The budget is a union over frames and readings.** The fitted modulus and the choices of the rule that is meant to replace
the fit are counted side by side; several inputs stand under two frames' names. It over-counts, which is the safe direction,
and it is not the price of any one value: a value's price is its own certificate's list.

### How each input could leave the budget

Read from three notes of the advisor seat (its forcing ledger, its statement of the closed loop, its design of the first
back-edge; pinned at `e7703f2ec`), each read in full and checked by main in B1867. This is a harvest of those notes onto the
budget. It is not a sweep of the record, and it changes no grade: an argument is not a proof, and a named back-edge is not
a built one.

| kind | inputs | what it means |
|---|---|---|
| KEPT | 3 | the principle itself: a parameter-free theory keeps it, stated |
| FORCING ARGUED | 2 | an argument that the principle forces it is written down, with no objection on this page; not proved |
| ONE CLAUSE SHORT | 3 | a forcing argument is written down, and main has shown the clause it lacks; not an exit as written |
| ADMITTED | 4 | the principle allows it and does not force it; no route is named |
| PRESSED | 3 | the notes argue against it standing as an input in its present form; no route is named |
| RIGID | 1 | fixed by the geometry once the history is fixed; what stays chosen is named |
| BACK-EDGE NAMED | 6 | a condition computed downstream that the choice must satisfy is named; none is built |
| DICTIONARY | 6 | an identification: the loop does not pay it; it is earned only by a sealed prediction |
| UNTOUCHED | 11 | the three notes name no route; the package holds the record's own |

## 4. The order of work

Two relations are kept apart.
- **Needs:** a package cannot be worked before these close. The waves are computed from it.
- **Given:** a package can be worked first, and its result is then conditional on these. A lane's result verified on main is still conditional on that lane's supplied inputs.

The builder projects every dependency edge of the map onto the packages (21 between different packages) and refuses
an order that leaves one out.

**WP-1.6 — The law and the weight** (DECIDE; STARTED; owner: main; the owner for the law's reading)

- **The question:** If everything allowed happens, what weighs it: does the execution itself force a weight, and does that weight single out one outcome?
- **The first step:** on the record: the height's law under each clock, the walk's exit law, the sealed draw test. Concentration under the move count, on the modulus's side, is answered (B1868, the web seat's sealed card verified on main): no atom, by a theorem; no concentration of mass; the density against area sharpens at one symmetric point and holds no weight there; under area nothing sharpens. So a declared clock gives a typical history and no value. Not computed by anyone: a rate function with a unique maximiser. The owner has ruled on the law's reading (P-755): the law is what takes part; the move count is not adopted as the weight; the weight stays open. 'Together' is defined (B1872, the web seat's definition verified): the joint action of the allowed histories on the shared records, which needs the allowed set closed under composition and its data on the shared records; read through what it fixes it selects nothing. Next: a read-out on the allowed subweave as a whole that its fixed data do not determine -- the minima of the joint action's own functional, or an index of the family over its quotient -- of which the record holds none; and the first back-edge's condition shown closed under composition, or restated as such a read-out.

## 7. The certificate

What every arc that a value uses must carry before the value may be sealed. The standard is the advisor seat's;
main adds two parts.

| part | what it means | whose |
|---|---|---|
| a recomputing lock | the lock recomputes the arc's number, and fails when the number is changed in a scratch copy | the advisor seat |
| a declared domain | one thread, a named set, all threads of a kind, or the weave; and how a census was reduced to one row | the advisor seat |
| a truncation list | everything removed from the carrier before computing, each entry graded forced, computational or chosen | the advisor seat |
| priced identifications | every reading of a mathematical quantity as a physical one on the path is earned, or is printed with the value as a condition | the advisor seat |
| a seal that precedes the result | a full hash for every sealed file, whatever its name, and the seal's commit a strict ancestor of the first result | the advisor seat |
| evidence in tracked files | every number cited has its script and its output in the repository; a lock reads only tracked files and compares no printed float as text | the advisor seat |
| re-derived on main | a seat's result is recomputed by main's own code before it is used; main's own by a second method | main's addition: main is the final verifier |
| challenged | a reader who did not write it has read it in full, and every must-fix finding is applied where the corrected line stands | main's addition: the review's practice |

**The status of a value, computed from everything it uses by the weakest link:**

| status | when |
|---|---|
| DERIVED | every ancestor is a foundation item or a theorem or exact computation carrying the certificate; every identification on the path is earned; nothing on the path is chosen or fitted; no weave result rests on a thread without a named lifting theorem |
| CONDITIONAL | as DERIVED but for a listed set of postulates beyond the foundation, choices or unearned identifications; the list is printed with the value |
| FITTED | an ancestor took a continuous value from data |
| UNVERIFIED | an ancestor has no recomputing lock, no script in tracked files, or no declared domain |

**The seal's rule:**

1. A value is sealed only as DERIVED. Everything it uses is proved, refuted or a foundation item; an open, conditional, lane-graded or debt node upstream keeps the seal closed, and so does one arc without the certificate.
2. The certificate is a generated file: the list of everything the value uses, with each part above per arc. The seal is refused without it. A dry run on the record's candidate, by the advisor seat, was refused on six grounds before any statistical question.
3. The comparison uses the instruments the record already holds, and no parallel protocol: the foundation's seven conditions for earning a dictionary by prediction, the input-completeness ledger's checklist for any cell that meets measured physics, and one look ledger. The owner's hold on the two unspent targets stands until the owner lifts it.
4. Parameter-free keeps the meaning the record gave it: zero free dimensionless parameters, with at most two declared anchors sealed in advance, and more outputs than anchors. The owner has confirmed the claim of one self-consistent outcome (2026-11-10): a fitted or chosen continuous input counts against the claim, not as a parameter of it.
5. The owner has confirmed the ruling on the count (2026-11-10): the headline is to be printed from the graph and typed nowhere -- confirmed, refuted, predictions registered, not reached. Until that is built (WP-0.12) the typed count stands and is marked as typed.

## 8. The advisor seat's audit, finding by finding

The audit read main as it stood on 2026-11-07. Its own rule is that a finding is reproduced on main before anything
is banked. OPEN: not yet reproduced on main. READER: main's reader reproduced it and main has not repeated the check.
REPRODUCED: main's own check. PARTLY FIXED: part of the acceptance row is met, and the note says what is left.
FIXED: main meets the whole row as main reads it; that seat's re-audit decides.

Two more columns, added at the advisor seat's read of this page as a non-author. *Bears on* names what the finding touches:
arcs, nodes of the map, pages, or REPOSITORY for a property of the repository as a whole that a seal depends on. *The
re-audit* is that seat's verdict on main's fix, kept apart from main's own word. Each verdict is of main at the commit its
re-audit read (re-audit 2 read main at `ab97082c0`; re-audit 3 read main at `b28dceea8`; re-audit 4 read main at `015be0cc7`; re-audit 5 read main at `16b82acda`; re-audit 6 read main at `8d90a5b2a`; re-audit 7 read main at `338b14fe3`), and each is read in the row of the seat's own file.

answered is given here in plain words, and nothing he said is quoted (register row P-796): he confirmed them, and asked for main's opinion on each of them.
